unlisted_practices: Domain-specific parameter-efficient fine-tuning of an LLM on a curated traditional Chinese medicine dataset
Combined automated metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, METEOR, BERTScore, embedding distance) and expert qualitative evaluation for TCM LLMs

screen.reason: The paper focuses on building and benchmarking a specialized traditional Chinese medicine LLM (XuanHuGPT) using parameter-efficient fine-tuning on a constructed dataset, evaluated via automated metrics and expert rating.
